request: 配置 GPT 定时器，1ms 周期中断
config:
```yaml
Gpt:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  GptChannel:
    - id: 0
      name: Timer_1ms
      period_us: 1000
      mode: PERIODIC
      enable_interrupt: true
```
